thesis: Shopify qualifies as a Compounder. Core score is 79.40 with full coverage, ex-valuation quality is 82.74, Compounder gates clear, and every Hard Veto is cleared. The company is not a strong expectation-gap setup at $128.50: locked Base is $124.44, so the investment case rests on durable compounding rather than an obvious valuation discount. Mechanical state is NORMAL_CANDIDATE with a 2-4% range; macro overlay slows purchase pacing to 0.7x but does not alter the score or position band.

evidence.claim: Locked price/Base is 1.0326; Bear/Base/Bull values are $41.03/$124.44/$220.24.
Q2 2026 GMV grew 32%, revenue 34%, operating income 68%, and FCF margin reached 18%.
Payments penetration reached 68%, App Store breadth exceeded 21,000 apps at year-end 2025, and UCP/Catalog extend the platform into AI commerce.
TTM owner FCF is about $2.35B and diluted shares declined YoY; H1 repurchases averaged $114.63, below locked Base value.

counterevidence: Bear value is only about 32% of spot, so valuation compression can still cause large drawdowns.
Founder voting control is a persistent governance discount.
Merchant credit and Payments increase exposure to consumer/transaction cycles.
The frozen price already reflects approximately the Base long-run FCF path, limiting a clear expectation gap.
unknowns: Normalized merchant-credit losses over a recession.
Long-run payment take economics and regulatory/competitive pressure.
falsifiers: If MT or RF falls below Compounder thresholds, price/Base rises above 1.2 without higher intrinsic value, or FCF/share decouples negatively from GMV for multiple periods, Compounder eligibility must be re-tested.

key_kpis.name: GMV / Payments penetration
key_kpis.threshold: platform and wallet share remain strong
